title: FIRSTDATE and LASTDATE return the first and last selected date, each as a table
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( FIRSTDATE ( 'Date'[Date] ), 'Date'[Date] >= DATE ( 2024, 2, 10 ) && 'Date'[Date] <= DATE ( 2024, 3, 10 ) ) EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( LASTDATE ( 'Date'[Date] ), 'Date'[Date] >= DATE ( 2024, 2, 10 ) && 'Date'[Date] <= DATE ( 2024, 3, 10 ) )

source.quote: FIRSTDATE returns the minimum date selected, as a table.
source.supports: the example with two EVALUATE statements returns the first and the last date of the selection

derivation: The selection is 2024-02-10 to 2024-03-10: the first date is 2024-02-10 and the last 2024-03-10. Two EVALUATE statements give two results.
